rationale: The piece reads as a committed 1846 newspaper editorial: it invokes Manifest Destiny, litigates the Rio Grande vs. Nueces boundary, praises General Taylor and predicts short victory, and contains no modern hedging or moralizing. The frame never breaks and the author writes in-era justifications throughout (security, indemnity, civilization).
quote: "While Texas and the United States understand the Rio Grande as the rightful line, Mexico absurdly claims the Nueces"
